newsitem.title: USA: BOLDER Tech files for 2.6 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: BOLDER Tech files for 2.6 mln shr offer.

text.p: BOLDER Technologies Corp said Friday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement for a proposed public offering of 2.6 million shares of common stock.
The company said it would offer 2.0 million shares and certain shareholders the other 600,000.

It said it planned to use the net proceeds of the offering to build high-volume, fully-automated production lines and other capital expenditures, product development and working capital, among other things.

The company also said it had agreed to sell its batteries to Booster PAC International of Quebec, a division of Century Manufacturing Co of Bloomington, Minnesota. It said Booster had chosen its two-volt, 1.2 Ampere-hour, 9/5 sub-C cell for three of its future models but did not disclose the quantity or the value of the order.
BOLDER Technologies is an energy technology company that develops and commercializes advanced, high power, rechargeable battery systems.
